messages.subject: inla.stack() issue
parts:
Hi Everyone, 
I am new to INLA. Currently, I am getting the error while running the function inla.stack(). I have spent a lot of time on that, but I was not able to figure it out. Can anyone help me with that?

stack.est = INLA::inla.stack(data = list(y = dfg$y),
                             A = list(A,1),
                       effects = list(c(field.indices,list(Intercept=1)),
             list(df[,c(5:6)])), tag="est")

Error in as.character(sys.call(sys.parent())[[1L]]) :
  cannot coerce type 'closure' to vector of type 'character'.

I also tried to replicate the code from the inla book.https://sites.google.com/a/r-inla.org/stbook/r-code -> chapter 7. R for the Air pollution in Piemonte.
But still, I get the same error there. Can anyone please help me to understand what mistake I am making here.

Thanks in advance.

Regards,
Kapil

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] inla.stack() issue
parts:
Hi,

first, check what's in your input variables;
str(dfg)
str(dfg$y)
str(df)
str(df[,c(5:6)])

For example, is "dfg" a typo, and should be "df" instead?

Also provide the output from
traceback()
since that may help trace what part of the code is triggering the error message.

Finn
